nodes.label: ADR-016 Fail-closed legacy KKPRL artifacts
nodes.summary: Accepted 2026-08-28: snapshot, revision and renderer reject nonconfigured private disks before reading bytes; explicitly supersedes ADR-009 legacy compatibility.
nodes.rationale: Legacy database rows could reference public storage despite new-model protections.
nodes.status: Accepted; supersedes ADR-009 old-disk compatibility for KKPRL only
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Private-disk manifest rejection before binary read
nodes.summary: Snapshot/revision/renderer reject any disk other than configured kkprl.storage_disk, default kkprl_private; no public or other-disk fallback.
nodes.rationale: Legacy rows bypassing model guards must not open untrusted public storage paths.

nodes.label: Verified legacy artifact migration
nodes.summary: No automatic move/delete; revalidate bytes, copy to random private name, update via official service and verify checksum/access.
nodes.rationale: Migration must preserve evidence and prove confidentiality before allowing export/revision reuse.

edges.evidence: Explicitly supersedes ADR-009 legacy-disk compatibility for KKPRL artifacts
